title: Wolf and Sigil
author: I. M. Marchetti
blurb: Hazel Voss, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
